profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer in Reinforcement Learning at Apptronik
profile.summary: I am a Senior Software Engineer working on Reinforcement Learning at Apptronik. I obtained my Ph.D. in Electrical and Computer Engineering at The Ohio State University. My research focuses on the intersection of Control Systems and Reinforcement Learning to design feedback controllers that render robust and stable locomotion of biped robots.  I am passionate about Robotics, Control Systems, and Machine Learning. In particular, I like to work on implementing model-free and model-based controllers in simulation and hardware.  I love practicing sports, especially basketball, soccer, and cycling.
